title: DiffLTM: Continuous Diffusions Large Tabular Models for Conditional Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional generation is a key capability to be supported by Large Tabular Models, enabling a number of applications. Accurate conditional generation has to contend with two key challenges: $(i)$ Data comprise a mixture of numerical and categorical entries, the latter often with high cardinality and heavily unbalanced proportions; $(ii)$ Conditional generation becomes increasingly difficult for rare sub-populations. The best models in this class use a hybrid of continuous and discrete diffusions. In this paper, we design a continuous diffusion model with strong generation quality. An important element is the use of cross-entropy loss for categoricals, for which we provide a first theoretical justification. We introduce metrics that focus on rare subpopulations. translated_title: DiffLTM：用于条件生成的连续扩散大型表格模型
translated_abstract: 条件生成是大型表格模型所需支持的一项关键能力，能够支撑众多应用。准确的条件生成必须应对两个关键挑战：(i) 数据由数值型与类别型条目混合组成，后者通常具有高基数且类别比例严重不平衡；(ii) 对于稀有子群体，条件生成变得越来越困难。此类模型中表现最佳者采用连续扩散与离散扩散相结合的混合方法。在本文中，我们设计了一个具有强大生成质量的连续扩散模型。其中一个重要元素是对类别特征使用交叉熵损失，我们为此提供了首个理论证明。我们引入了专注于稀有子群体的评估指标。此外，我们对条件生成技术进行了泛化，以支持新类型的条件控制。最后，我们展示了我们的模型（在劳动力数据上训练）能够捕捉经典的洞察
tldr: 本文提出DiffLTM——一种用于表格数据条件生成的连续扩散大型模型，通过为类别特征引入交叉熵损失并给出首个理论证明、设计针对稀有子群体的评估指标以及泛化条件生成技术，在混合数值与类别数据上实现了强大的生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DiffLTM, a continuous diffusion large tabular model for conditional generation, which achieves strong generation quality on mixed numerical and categorical data by introducing cross-entropy loss for categoricals with the first theoretical justification, designing metrics focused on rare subpopulations, and generalizing conditional generation techniques.
